title: KherveTeX (kherveDOC): A WYSIWYG LaTeX document editor with Git-based version history

creators.name: Kerhervé, Gwilherm
creators.affiliation: Department of Materials, Imperial College London

description: KherveTeX (kherveDOC) is an open-source WYSIWYG document editor that produces publication-quality PDFs via LaTeX. Documents are edited on a Word-style page surface backed by a typed document model, serialised to LaTeX and compiled live with the tectonic engine. It supports inline and display mathematics, figures, tables, citations, cross-references, footnotes, .docx and .tex import, and per-document Git version history with auto-commit and push.
